report.summary: Around 19:07:50 UTC, payment-service became unreachable, causing checkout requests from order-service to time out. This led to increased latency for customers and orders failing or becoming stuck in unknown payment states.
report.root_cause: payment-service unreachability/outage starting at 2026-10-18T19:07:50Z (up metric dropped to 0), causing order-service payment requests to time out with CancellationException

evidence.finding: The 'up' metric for instance 'payment-service:8083' dropped from 1.0 to 0.0 at 2026-10-18T19:07:50Z.
At 2026-10-18T19:08:00Z, 7 orders resulted in PAYMENT_UNKNOWN status and 20 orders remained in PENDING status.
order-service recorded 207 ERROR log lines between 2026-10-18T19:08:39Z and 19:10:28Z with java.util.concurrent.CancellationException: Payment outcome unknown, needs reconciliation.
order-service p95 latency spiked to 353.44 ms at 2026-10-18T19:08:41Z (up from 49.91 ms at 19:04:41Z).

timeline: 19:04:00 UTC - System processing heavy load normally (25,659 confirmed orders).
19:07:50 UTC - Prometheus scrape for payment-service fails (up metric = 0).
19:08:00 UTC - Order status degrades with 7 PAYMENT_UNKNOWN and 20 PENDING orders.
19:08:39 UTC - order-service begins logging java.util.concurrent.CancellationException errors for timed out payment requests.
19:08:41 UTC - order-service p95 latency peaks at 353.44 ms.
report.customer_impact: 7 orders ended in PAYMENT_UNKNOWN status requiring manual reconciliation to check if customers were billed, 20 orders remained stuck in PENDING status, and checkout response times degraded up to ~353ms.
ruled_out: Recent code deployment: get_recent_deployments returned 0 deployments in the last 30 minutes.
Database pool exhaustion in inventory-service or order-service: db_pool_pending remained at 0 across all services during the window.
recommended_actions: Check payment-service process health and container logs to diagnose why the service dropped offline at 19:07:50 UTC.
Run financial reconciliation for the 7 PAYMENT_UNKNOWN orders to confirm customer charging status and finalize or cancel those orders.
Review order-service timeout settings and implement circuit breaking for calls to toxiproxy/payment-service to fail fast during payment outages.
